ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This course will open to Business Administration majors on Monday, May 3, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to all students in Gies College of Business on Monday, May 10, 2021 around 10:00am. This section will open to ILEE students on Monday, May 17, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 seats reserved for Gies College of Business international exchange students only (any exchange students outside of GCOB who try to register will be removed); any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, August 27, 2021 at approximately 10:00 a.m.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Accountancy or Finance or Marketing or Information Sys & Info Tech or Supply Chain Management or Business Process Management or Management or Innov, Ldshp and Engr Entr or Information Systems or Operations Management or STR BUS DEV & Entrepreneurship major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
